ops.text: The step resolves capt-hook's dependencies through the package index (uv tool install), while the earlier sync installs from URLs pinned in uv.lock. For a few minutes after a dependency release the index did not yet list the new version, so a PR that moves a pin to a release published minutes earlier fails this one job. The diff was not the cause. capt-hookd already waits for its own release to resolve (awaitProductRelease) but nothing waits for a freshly published dependency; a re-run after propagation is the current remedy.
